build_qrdqn_trainer: build a QR-DQN trainer with q_network, target network, and quantile regression parameters
configure_optimizers_qrdqn: configure optimizers for the QR-DQN trainer including soft update scheduler for target network
run_train_step_qrdqn: run a training step generator that computes quantile regression loss on a discrete DQN batch
review_boost_rewards: review the boost_rewards method that applies action-specific reward boosts to training rewards
test_argmax_with_mask: test the argmax_with_mask method that selects best action while masking impossible actions
